title: rosa × dumetorum var. schergiana
intro: Rosa × dumetorum var. schergiana, commonly known as Scherg's rose, is a variety of rose species known for its medicinal properties. This plant is used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties that may help soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Rosa × dumetorum var. schergiana include astringent, antiseptic, and antispasmodic effects, which can help to reduce bleeding, prevent infection, and alleviate muscle cramps. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
